created_by: repository-audit agent; manually reviewed public source metadata candidates
annotation_status: development judgments, not external user annotation, not blind holdout, not independently adjudicated
privacy: Only public question UUIDs, minimal public labels/topic/book/prompt excerpts. No Attempts, Notes, answers, users, credentials or full corpus export.
selection_method: Representative user-requested terms; inspect literal source candidates and concept-equivalent Chinese terms independently of actual search-engine result order; manually select positives and realistic nearby negatives.

grades.3: Direct requested concept, exact identifier, or exact requested book member; aliases judged semantically, not by engine support.
grades.2: Clearly relevant secondary relation or public chapter-only match; image contents remain unknown.
grades.1: Weak adjacent concept, insufficient direct intent evidence; must not outrank direct matches.
grades.0: Inspected irrelevant/contradictory hard negative, not simply an unjudged document.

evaluation_contract.unjudged: Unknown, never silently treat every unlisted UUID as irrelevant or claim exhaustive corpus recall.
primary_metrics: MRR of grade>=2 among full raw engine result positions
KnownRelevantRecall@24 (only listed grade>=2 denominators, not true corpus recall)
JudgedCoverage@10; separately report fraction of returned top10 that have explicit judgments
evaluation_contract.graded_metrics: Report condensed nDCG@10 only with label: removes unjudged results, optimistic partial-qrels measure. Never claim it is full-corpus unbiased nDCG. Raw nDCG treating unjudged as0 may be diagnostic only and must be labeled lower-bound/biased.
evaluation_contract.empty_queries: REAL-Q36..40: expected returned question count0 and no exception; literal scans cannot prove absence in un-OCRed images. REAL-Q41: browse semantics, excluded from relevance averages.
evaluation_contract.compare: Run legacy and hybrid against the same real imported snapshot, same workspace and filters, no private query scope, same fixed index version; save actual UUID lists and timings separately.
evaluation_contract.release_limit: This development set is not the Master Plan independent real-user holdout release gate. Obtain user/blind review before asserting that gate has passed.
evaluation_contract.performance_fixture: Do not reuse real UUID qrels against synthetic93000-row UUIDs. For 10x performance, retain real9281 corpus unchanged plus clearly marked distractors, or measure synthetic performance separately without relevance claims.
